sourcePolicy: Official EU institutions, national sources and quality European tech journalism. Stories without a clear EU or European-country angle are excluded. Retention window is 120 days.

articles.title: EuroHPC signs EUR387.8M contract for LUMI-AI supercomputer in Finland
articles.description: EuroHPC JU awarded French vendor Bull a EUR387.8 million contract to deploy LUMI-AI in Kajaani, the sixth AI Factory machine, aiming for a tenfold rise in AI capacity versus current LUMI.
articles.content: The system will sit at CSC Kajaani data centre and serve the LUMI AI Factory consortium of Finland, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Norway and Poland. It will use AMD Instinct MI430X GPUs and 6th-gen EPYC CPUs, with installation planned for the second half of 2027. EuroHPC and the consortium split the cost 50/50. Aimed first at European startups and SMEs.

articles.title: Spain awards EUR180 million for company AI projects and publishes an AI Atlas
articles.description: Madrid selected 372 Red IA and Red IA Salud projects, 70 percent SMEs, and released Atlas de la IA.
articles.content: Digital transformation minister Oscar Lopez said grants will fund digital assistants, twins, robotics, vision and cybersecurity. Atlas covers AESIA, the EU first AI sandbox, Alia, training and infrastructure. Spain remains confident of an EU AI Gigafactory site.

articles.title: Commission designates ChatGPT, Reddit and Roblox under the Digital Services Act
articles.description: The European Commission designated ChatGPT as a Very Large Online Search Engine, and Reddit and Roblox as Very Large Online Platforms under the DSA.
articles.content: Designations bring extra DSA duties on systemic risks including minors, fundamental rights and public security. Obligations apply alongside other EU digital rules.

articles.title: Bull wins Europe EUR387.8 million LUMI-AI build after Atos carve-out
articles.description: French state-owned Bull said the EuroHPC LUMI-AI award is its largest contract, months after Paris bought the business out of Atos.
articles.content: Reuters reports Europe is expanding publicly funded AI supercomputers. Bull will deliver a liquid-cooled BullSequana system with AMD GPUs, IBM storage and Nokia networking. Funding is split between EuroHPC and the hosting consortium.

articles.title: At TechBBQ, Europe's AI conversations kept coming back to who's actually in control
articles.description: TechCrunch coverage of Copenhagen TechBBQ highlights who controls models, infrastructure and decisions in European AI.
articles.content: Investors and founders debated control as AI embeds in products and public life, linking capability with foreign-platform dependence and accountability.

articles.title: DiscreteStack raises EUR800k seed round to build European AI infrastructure
articles.description: DiscreteStack raised EUR800,000 seed to expand AI infrastructure for European businesses in regulated sectors.
articles.content: The Bulgarian startup will expand into regulated sectors and add GPU capacity, pitching on-prem and sovereign infrastructure.

articles.title: Maastricht's Clementine raises EUR1.7M to scale its AI hearing-care agent
articles.description: Dutch startup Clementine closed a EUR1.7 million seed led by Healthy.Capital for its AI hearing-care agent.
articles.content: Founded in Maastricht in 2024, Clementine answers clinic inquiries and guides patients into care. Funding will deepen the product and expand European and North American partnerships.

articles.title: Paris-based Hugging Face launches $399 open-source Microduck robot
articles.description: Hugging Face and Pollen Robotics unveiled Microduck, a $399 open-source robot trainable with reinforcement learning.
articles.content: The 25cm robot walks, picks objects and ships with sensors. SDK and training stack are open source. Pre-orders topped $2.6 million in 24 hours.

articles.title: German startups raise a record EUR9.36 billion as capital shifts to AI, robotics and defence
articles.description: PitchBook data in Handelsblatt show German startups raised EUR9.36 billion from January to July 2026, led by AI, robotics and defence.
articles.content: Helsing, Quantum Systems and Stark Defence raised more than EUR3 billion earlier in the year; Neura Robotics added more than EUR1 billion in July.

articles.title: EU AI Act regulatory framework enters its application phase
articles.description: The Commission AI Act framework explains application from 2 August 2026, including the AI Office and national authorities.
articles.content: Official overview of the risk-based framework, timeline and enforcement authorities.

articles.title: Poland prepares a special law to speed an AI Gigafactory bid of up to EUR10 billion
articles.description: Warsaw is considering fast-track legislation and has pledged compute offtake for a mid-sized EU AI Gigafactory.
articles.content: Poland signed the EuroHPC joint procurement agreement. Public support could reach EUR1 billion. Officials describe a mid-scale facility of at least 75,000 AI accelerators.

articles.title: Spain is the only EU bidder putting the state in control of an AI Gigafactory consortium
articles.description: SETT holds 47.99 percent of the Spanish EU AI Gigafactory consortium, plus a 1 percent Catalan stake.
articles.content: Other member states back bids with money or offtake but not controlling equity. Spain makes the state the largest shareholder.

articles.title: Itoflow raises 1.8m pounds to build AI agents for investment teams
articles.description: UK startup Itoflow closed a $2.5m pre-seed led by Balderton for governed AI agent research workflows.
articles.content: Agents learn how investors research, manage risk and review portfolios. Capital expands engineering and commercial work.

articles.title: Mistral and Saudi HUMAIN strike a hundreds-of-millions sovereign AI pact
articles.description: Paris-based Mistral will work with PIF-owned HUMAIN on infrastructure, cybersecurity, voice and Arabic models.
articles.content: Announced during the Saudi crown prince visit to Paris. Mistral keeps EU model development while exploring inference in Saudi data centres.

articles.title: Amsterdam Neno raises EUR6.6M to scale AI-native accounting across Europe
articles.description: Neno closed a EUR6.6 million seed led by AlleyCorp to expand AI accounting, tax and payroll for European SMEs.
articles.content: Launched in early 2026 with nearly 200 customers. Motive Partners, Firstminute Capital and angels joined. Funds support European expansion and Neno Labs.

articles.title: Lunar founders raise EUR8.2M for AI-native audit firm Repodo
articles.description: Former Lunar executives closed Denmark largest pre-seed for licensed AI audit firm Repodo.
articles.content: Hedosophia and Seed Capital led the EUR8.2 million round. The Copenhagen firm will start with Danish SMEs and expand across Europe. Humans keep final audit sign-off.

articles.title: AI takes 60 percent of European venture value in H1 2026
articles.description: PitchBook-based analysis finds AI absorbed 60.3 percent of European deal value in H1 2026.
articles.content: European startups raised EUR44.1 billion across just over 1,740 deals. Helsing closed $1.8 billion at an $18 billion valuation in July.

articles.title: France H1 2026 tech ledger is led by AI labs AMI and Mistral
articles.description: Tech.eu ranking shows AMI raising a $1 billion seed and Mistral adding $830 million.
articles.content: AMI, founded by Yann LeCun and Alexandre LeBrun, plans teams in Paris and abroad. Mistral is expanding into agents and training infrastructure.

articles.title: UK startup Callosum raises $100 million seed to run AI across mixed chips and models
articles.description: Cambridge-founded Callosum closed a $100 million seed led by Atomico.
articles.content: Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI programme participated. Callosum runs workloads across heterogeneous chips and models.

articles.title: Danish startup Velatir raises EUR5M seed for sovereign AI infrastructure
articles.description: Copenhagen-based Velatir closed a EUR5 million seed to expand its Europe-hosted AI management layer.
articles.content: Platform runs on European-owned infrastructure rather than US hyperscalers. EIFO provided a matching loan.

articles.title: Stuttgart Flip raises $25M to bring AI agents to frontline workers
articles.description: German employee-experience platform Flip closed $25 million from HV Capital, Notion Capital and L-Bank.
articles.content: Flip serves deskless staff in manufacturing, retail, logistics, care and hospitality. Products include Fusion, an AI Agent Gateway and Frontline Identity.

articles.title: German startup amber raises EUR7M Series A for enterprise knowledge AI
articles.description: Amber closed a EUR7 million Series A led by NRW.Venture and Ventech.
articles.content: Cologne-area firm builds an AI data layer over email, documents and internal systems for manufacturers and mid-market firms.

articles.title: CEPR analysis: AI Act transparency applies while high-risk rules slip to 2027-28
articles.description: Digital Omnibus left Article 50 transparency in force on 2 August 2026 while standalone high-risk obligations move to December 2027.
articles.content: Regulation 2026/1744 deferred Annex III high-risk rules by 16 months and product-embedded high-risk AI to August 2028.

articles.title: AI Act enforcement begins as Brussels sets out who polices GPAI and transparency
articles.description: From 2 August 2026 the AI Office and national authorities enforce GPAI rules, transparency duties and prohibited practices.
articles.content: AI Office can request documentation, evaluate models and fine GPAI providers. High-risk rules delayed to 2027-28.

articles.title: Commission starts enforcing AI Act rules and transparency duties from 2 August
articles.description: AI Office and national authorities began enforcing the AI Act on 2 August 2026, including AI-interaction disclosure and content marking.
articles.content: Chatbots must tell users they are AI. Deepfakes must be labelled. High-risk system rules remain deferred by the AI Omnibus.

articles.title: EU opens call for up to seven AI Gigafactories to unlock more than EUR30 billion
articles.description: EuroHPC and the Commission launched a tender for up to seven industry-led AI Gigafactories.
articles.content: Up to EUR10 billion public funds and at least EUR20 billion private investment targeted. Call closes 12 November 2026.

articles.title: Commission publishes Article 50 guidelines on AI transparency duties
articles.description: On 20 July 2026 the Commission issued guidelines on disclosing AI interactions and labelling synthetic content from 2 August.
articles.content: Providers must design systems so users know they interact with AI and mark generated content. Deployers must label deepfakes and certain biometric uses.
